svg.title: Complete end-to-end architecture of the genomic sequence classification project
svg.desc: One system-level architecture with six processing stages and two independent execution lanes: pangenome-to-DNABERT and FASTA-to-classical machine learning. Includes inputs, graph processing, representations, training, inference, evaluation, interfaces, storage and limitations.
svg.text: GENOMIC SEQUENCE CLASSIFICATION: COMPLETE END-TO-END ARCHITECTURE
Pangenome-based pathogenicity research + APP / PSEN1 / PSEN2 gene classification | Implementation-based system view
B | FASTA GENE SEQUENCES -> CLASSICAL MACHINE LEARNING
Graph, k, length, path caps, seed
Read H / S / L / P records
Token IDs must match embedding rows
Never choose the threshold on test labels
No accuracy claim without verified labels
Saved checkpoint reused in later runs
Dataset folder selected by the user
Enters inference at stage 5, not training
Uppercase; retain A / C / G / T
At least 5 training samples per gene/class
Fit on each training fold only
Optional tuning + soft voting via CLI/engine
Highest mean CV macro F1 wins
Never choose the winner using holdout scores
Selected preprocessing travels with the model
Replaced by retraining; lost on restart
Selected gene must have a trained reference
Do not refit on uploaded sequences
Exact duplicates are audited, not grouped
Dashboard JSON; CLI can save plot PNGs
Model probabilities are not disease risks
Reserved holdout -> selected pipeline -> test evaluation
A and B are two execution paths within one project.
READING GUIDE: solid arrows = processing / model flow; dashed route = classical holdout evaluation. Uploads enter stage 5 directly.
Browser: Bootstrap + Chart.js; external CDN assets.
Training requests are synchronous; no job queue.
DNABERT runs separately through main.py CLI.
Local files + in-memory Python / NetworkX objects.
PyTorch: CPU or available CUDA; scikit-learn: local.
No database, distributed worker or model registry.
SCC order, strand orientation and overlaps are simplified.
Long DNABERT inputs truncate; labels need path mapping.
Helper-generated graph flanks are synthetic, not loci.
Related-sample leakage and clinical validity not resolved.
utils.py: configuration, seed usage and logging support.
generate_report.py: static report helper, not live results.
No automatic fusion, diagnosis or proven accuracy gain.
